provenance.rule: Stage 7 preserves one refined object per Stage-6 line. Receipt context may propagate Store, Store Number, and Date 1 to genuine purchase items. Product remains an editable best guess for every source line. Historical Purchase History may support identity/Common Name/Sub-Category but never supplies a current receipt Price 1 or Date 1.
